overview.holdsDescription: Held quantities are outside inventory until an inspection passes; only accepted quantities are eligible for stock.
overview.nothingHeldDetail: No rejected, quarantined or disputed quantity is waiting on a decision.
overview.costBasisTitle: Accepted quantities awaiting a cost basis
overview.costBasisDescription: Until an evidenced cost basis exists for every accepted unit, the receipt cannot be posted.
overview.allCostBasedDetail: Every accepted quantity already has an evidenced cost basis.
overview.postingTitle: Accepted quantities not yet in stock
overview.postingDescriptionEnabled: Posting is enabled for this business; these receipts will move stock once their cost basis is complete.
overview.postingDescriptionDisabled: Posting is disabled for this business, so these receipts stay out of stock even when fully costed.
overview.allPostedDetail: Every accepted quantity has reached stock.
overview.claimsDescription: Rejected material never entered inventory, and quarantined or disputed material is not yet the entity's. Both are listed here for period close.
overview.noClaimsDetail: No rejected, quarantined or disputed quantity is open with a supplier.
overview.blockedBillsDescription: These bills already moved stock through the ordinary purchase path, so the construction matcher refuses them: one bill must not create two receipts.

materialIssues.successNotice: Issued {{quantity}} base units at {{cost}} per base unit (project {{project}}). One outbound stock movement; no journal entry.
materialIssues.loadError: Material issues could not be loaded: {{detail}}
materialIssues.issueTitle: Issue material to a construction site
materialIssues.issueDescription: Consumption is valued by the server at the pool weighted-average cost. You supply the site, the product, the unit and the quantity — never the cost.
materialIssues.policyNoteBefore: An issue is gated on the same approved policy as receipt posting. It writes one outbound stock movement and
materialIssues.policyNoteAfter: : the project-cost debit has no approved account mapping, so only the inventory side is recorded.
materialIssues.postingDisabledNote: Movement posting is disabled for this business, so the database will refuse this issue even when the form is complete.
materialIssues.siteHint: The site fixes the branch, inventory location and project reference.
materialIssues.issuedToHint: For example the crew or the works supervisor.
materialIssues.evidenceHint: The signed site requisition or issue note.
materialIssues.availableSuffix: . The issue is valued at that cost and cannot exceed the available quantity.
materialIssues.noStockBalance: No stock balance exists yet for this product at that site store.
materialIssues.requiredReason: A site, a product, a unit, a quantity and an evidence reference are required.
materialIssues.postingDisabledPill: Movement posting disabled for this business
materialIssues.projectCostDescription: Derived by the server from the append-only issue register, grouped by project reference. There is no stored project-cost balance.
materialIssues.issuedDescription: Append-only history of every issue, with the cost the server applied.
materialIssues.balancesDescription: Read from the shared inventory balance table — the same table the stock commands maintain.

materialReturns.successNotice: Returned {{quantity}} base units at {{cost}} per base unit (project {{project}}). One inbound stock movement at the original issue cost; the project's net material cost falls by the same amount. No journal entry.
materialReturns.loadError: Material returns could not be loaded: {{detail}}
materialReturns.returnTitle: Return usable material to the store
materialReturns.returnDescription: Choose the original material issue and the quantity coming back. The server takes the site, store, project, unit cost and base quantity from that issue.
materialReturns.noteP1Before: A return is recorded at the
materialReturns.noteP1After: , so the project’s net material cost falls by exactly what it was charged. The material re-enters the store’s weighted-average pool, which re-prices that pool — including for later issues to other projects.
materialReturns.noteP2After: : general-ledger posting is not approved. Returns cannot exceed what the issue still has outstanding, and the unit of measure is always the issue’s own.
materialReturns.noteP3: Wastage, damage, write-downs and cross-site returns are deliberately not available here — they are outside the approved Phase 1 scope.
materialReturns.noneReturnableDetail: Every recorded issue has already been returned in full, or no material has been issued to a construction site yet.
materialReturns.sourceIssueHint: Only issues with quantity still outstanding are listed. The issue fixes the branch, store, project and cost.
materialReturns.quantityHint: In {{uom}} (the unit the material was issued in).
materialReturns.returnDateHint: Cannot be earlier than the issue date, and must fall in an open period.
materialReturns.receivedByHint: The person who took the material back into the store.
materialReturns.evidenceHint: The document that authorises the return (site note, requisition, sign-off).
materialReturns.reasonHint: Why the material is coming back, e.g. surplus to the pour.
materialReturns.summaryTail: relieved from project {{project}}. {{remaining}} base units remain returnable on this issue.
materialReturns.exceedsError: That quantity is more than the issue still has outstanding. Reduce it, or choose another issue.
materialReturns.requiredReason: An original issue, a positive quantity, a return date, a reason and an evidence reference are required.
materialReturns.registerDescription: Append-only. A posted return is never edited or deleted; a mistake is corrected by a new opposite record.
materialReturns.noReturnsDetail: Returns appear here as soon as one is posted.

grnForm.title: Record goods receipt
grnForm.infoP1: Only the accepted quantity can ever reach stock, and only after an evidenced cost basis exists and the approved posting policy allows a movement. Rejected, quarantined and disputed quantities stay outside inventory and are reported as outstanding supplier claims.
grnForm.infoP2: No journal entry is created by a goods receipt.
grnForm.deliveryNoteHint: Link the supplier paperwork this receipt was checked against.
grnForm.doesNotBalance: Classification does not balance by {{difference}}: received must equal accepted + rejected + quarantined + disputed.
grnForm.holdNeeded: {{held}} unit(s) are not accepted and each needs a hold with a reason and evidence.
grnForm.noInspectCapability: Your account does not hold “Inspect and classify receipts”. The database will refuse this receipt; ask an approver to record it.
grnForm.overReceiptInfo: An over-receipt is refused unless an authorized reason and evidence are recorded. Leave these blank when receiving within the ordered quantity.
grnForm.submitHint: Enter at least one received quantity; the classification must balance and every hold needs a reason and evidence.

deliveryNoteForm.title: Record delivery note
deliveryNoteForm.exceptionTitle: Record duplicate delivery note — authorized exception
deliveryNoteForm.excP1Before: The supplier reused a delivery-note number that is
deliveryNoteForm.excP1After: for this supplier. This records the second document as an exception against the recorded one, and needs the exception authority plus a written reason and an evidence reference. The recorded note is not edited: construction procurement history is append-only.
deliveryNoteForm.excP2Before: It is still evidence only — the command returns
deliveryNoteForm.excP2After: . Nothing reaches stock until a goods receipt is recorded against the purchase order and the posting policy allows it.
deliveryNoteForm.conflictHint: Only the notes recorded for this supplier can be named. The server refuses any other note.
deliveryNoteForm.exceptionAgainst: This will be recorded as an exception against:
deliveryNoteForm.reusedHint: Taken from the recorded note being named. Read-only — it is the conflict.
deliveryNoteForm.numberHint: A duplicate for the same supplier is refused.
deliveryNoteForm.receivedByLabel: Received by (as written on the note)
deliveryNoteForm.evidenceHint: Where the signed delivery note is filed. Required by the command.
deliveryNoteForm.exceptionReasonHint: Why the supplier's reused number is being recorded rather than refused.
deliveryNoteForm.exceptionReasonPlaceholder: e.g. supplier reissued the same number for a second delivery
deliveryNoteForm.exceptionEvidenceHint: The document that supports the exception — a supplier e-mail, a reissued note, a memo.
deliveryNoteForm.exceptionSubmitHint: The recorded note it duplicates, an exception reason, an exception evidence reference, the note evidence reference and at least one declared quantity are required.
deliveryNoteForm.submitHint: A note number, an evidence reference and at least one declared quantity are required.

receipts.loadError: Goods receipts could not be loaded: {{detail}}
receipts.title: Goods receipts
receipts.description: A receipt records what was physically received and classified. Only accepted quantities can reach stock, and only after an evidenced cost basis and an approved policy.
receipts.noneDetail: Record one against an authorized purchase order from the Purchase orders screen.
receipts.detailLoadError: The receipt could not be loaded: {{detail}}
receipts.notVisible: That goods receipt is not visible to you in this business.
receipts.journalNoteStrong: one stock movement per receipt line
receipts.journalNoteAfter: through the shared weighted-average-cost writer. It does not write a journal entry: general-ledger posting for construction receipts is not approved.
receipts.postInfo: Posting is refused by the database unless (a) an approved policy enables movement posting, and (b) every accepted quantity on every line has an evidenced cost basis. Quantities already posted are skipped, so pressing this twice never doubles stock.
receipts.noReleasesDetail: Quarantined or disputed quantities stay outside inventory until released.
receipts.releaseRequiresReason: A written reason is required to release a hold.
receipts.releaseFooter: Releasing a hold records the decision. It does not move stock: a quarantined or disputed quantity must also pass an inspection and be reclassified before it can be accepted.
receipts.inspectionNotice: Inspection recorded on line {{line}}. An inspection does not move stock by itself.
receipts.releaseNotice: Quantity released from {{bucket}} into accepted on line {{line}}. Request an evidenced cost basis before posting.
receipts.noInspection: No inspection recorded for this line.
receipts.releaseHeading: Release held quantity into accepted (quarantined {{quarantined}} · disputed {{disputed}})
receipts.releasePAfter: inspection of this line covering the released quantity, plus the exception authority and a written reason. Rejected material can never be released, and accepted stock can never be released back out.
receipts.releaseSubmitHint: A quantity, a passed inspection, a reason and evidence are all required.
receipts.costBasisNotice: Cost basis recorded at {{cost}} per base unit (rate {{rate}}, discount {{discount}}, non-recoverable tax {{tax}}{{vatSuffix}}).
receipts.costBasisHeading: Supplier bill match and cost basis
receipts.unmatchedTitle: Not matched to a supplier bill line
receipts.unmatchedDetail: Cost cannot be claimed until a bill line is matched to this receipt line (Bill matching screen).
receipts.costEvidenceHint: For example the supplier invoice page reference.
receipts.allClaimed: Every matched bill quantity on this line has already been claimed.
receipts.costSubmitHint: A quantity and an evidence reference are required.
receipts.policyLine: Posting policy: {{state}}. Cost is derived by the server from the bill line: price net of the stated trade discount, plus tax only when it is not recoverable, at the rate recorded for the bill date.
receipts.nothingToPost: Nothing to post: every accepted quantity on this receipt has already reached stock.
receipts.movementsPosted: {{movements}} stock movement(s) posted through the shared weighted-average-cost writer. No journal entry was created.
receipts.policyAlsoDisabled: Movement posting is also disabled for this business.

purchaseOrders.title: Purchase orders
purchaseOrders.description: A purchase order authorizes procurement. It never moves stock, and it needs a different person to authorize it than the person who raised it.
purchaseOrders.registerSiteFirstDetail: A purchase order must name a registered site, which fixes its branch, inventory location and project reference.
purchaseOrders.createdNotice: Purchase order {{number}} created as a draft. A different person must authorize it.
purchaseOrders.noneDetail: Create the first one to start the procurement chain.
purchaseOrders.noMatchTitle: No purchase order matches that search
purchaseOrders.supplierHint: Only active supplier contacts of this business can be used.
purchaseOrders.currencyHint: The bill that later matches this order must be in the same currency.
purchaseOrders.setBaseUnitFirst: Set a base unit on the product first.
purchaseOrders.infoP1: The order is created as a draft. Authorization is a separate step and must be done by a different person (four eyes).
purchaseOrders.infoP2: Quantities are converted to the product base unit by the server using registered conversions only — an unregistered unit is refused.
purchaseOrders.submitHint: Choose a site, a supplier, a 3-letter currency and at least one complete line.
purchaseOrders.detailLoadError: The purchase order could not be loaded: {{detail}}
purchaseOrders.notVisible: That purchase order is not visible to you in this business.
purchaseOrders.fourEyesReason: You raised this purchase order. Authorization must be recorded by a different person.
purchaseOrders.cancelRequiresReason: A written reason is required to cancel.
purchaseOrders.noNoteForException: No delivery note is recorded for this supplier yet. Record the first note normally — this path only records a duplicate of an existing note.
purchaseOrders.deliveryNoteNotice: Delivery note {{number}} recorded as evidence. No stock or ledger effect.
purchaseOrders.deliveryNoteExceptionNotice: Delivery note {{number}} recorded as an authorized duplicate exception. The recorded note was not changed; no stock or ledger effect.
purchaseOrders.grnNoticeAccepted: Goods receipt {{number}} recorded. {{quantity}} base units were accepted and need an evidenced cost basis before posting.
purchaseOrders.grnNoticeNothing: Goods receipt {{number}} recorded. Nothing was accepted, so no quantity can reach stock.
purchaseOrders.dnNoneDetail: A delivery note records what the supplier's paperwork says; it never moves stock.
purchaseOrders.grnNoneDetail: A goods receipt is the only document that can lead to stock.
purchaseOrders.openReceiptLink: Open receipt, inspection and cost review →
purchaseOrders.inspectionNote: Goods receipt quantities are converted by the server with registered unit conversions only. Rejected, quarantined and disputed quantities each need a hold with a reason and evidence, and need the receipt-inspection capability.

billMatching.loadError: Bill matching could not be loaded: {{detail}}
billMatching.infoNote: One supplier reference can only be registered once per supplier. A genuine duplicate (for example a re-issued invoice number) needs an evidenced exception that names the conflicting registration. Matching is exact: same product, same supplier, same currency, explicit unit conversion — no tolerance is applied automatically.
billMatching.title: Supplier bills and their registered references
billMatching.description: The supplier's own invoice reference lives on the existing bill (expenses.reference). Registration is the duplicate guard that matching depends on.
billMatching.noneDetail: Record the bill in Expenses (with the supplier's own invoice reference) and mark it a construction procurement bill so the ordinary purchase hook does not receipt the stock.
billMatching.addReferenceFirst: Add the supplier’s own invoice reference to this bill first (Expenses).
billMatching.exceptionNotice: Supplier reference registered as an authorized duplicate exception. No stock movement and no journal entry were created.
billMatching.exceptionInfo: The supplier reused an invoice reference that is already registered for them. This records the bill as an exception against that registration. The conflicting registration is not edited — registrations are append-only — and this command creates no stock movement and no journal entry.
billMatching.conflictHint: Only active registrations can be named. The server refuses anything else.
billMatching.noActiveRegistrations: No active registration is visible in this business. An exception must name an existing active registration for the same supplier and the same reference, so there is nothing to record against yet.
billMatching.mismatchBefore: That registration carries a different reference from this bill. An exception must name the registration that holds the
billMatching.mismatchFallback: this bill has no reference recorded
billMatching.mismatchAfter: ), so the server would refuse this choice.
billMatching.exceptionReasonPlaceholder: e.g. supplier reissued the same invoice number
billMatching.alreadyRegisteredNote: If the server says this bill already has a registered reference, the registration exists — the list above has been refreshed and no duplicate was created. Check the registration column before submitting again.
billMatching.selectConflictReason: Select the registered reference this bill conflicts with.
billMatching.differentReferenceReason: The named registration holds a different reference from this bill.
billMatching.reasonEvidenceRequired: A written reason and an evidence reference are required.
billMatching.matchExceptionNotice: Match recorded as an authorized exception. No stock movement and no journal entry were created.
billMatching.matchNotice: Bill line matched to the receipt line. Matching creates no stock movement and no journal entry.
billMatching.matchTitle: Match a supplier bill line to a receipt line
billMatching.matchDescription: Split allocations across partial receipts and combined allocations to several bill lines are both supported. The server caps the matched quantity at the remaining bill-line quantity and the remaining accepted receipt quantity.
billMatching.supplierBillHint: Only bills whose supplier reference is registered can be matched.
billMatching.receiptLineHint: Which accepted line of the receipt this bill line corresponds to. The server caps the matched quantity at what that line still has available.
billMatching.billUnitHint: The unit the bill line is priced in. The server refuses a unit it cannot convert to the product base unit.
billMatching.receiptQuantityHint: What the bill quantity corresponds to on the receipt.
billMatching.exceptionSummary: Quantity difference or duplicate reference? Record an authorized exception
billMatching.exceptionInfoMatch: A bill quantity that differs from the receipt quantity is refused unless an authorizer records a reason and evidence. Left blank, the quantities must agree exactly — no tolerance is applied automatically.
billMatching.chooseAll: Choose a receipt, the receipt line, a bill line, the bill unit and both quantities.
billMatching.nothingAccepted: This receipt has no accepted quantity to match. Record the receipt, and accept the material on it, first.
billMatching.chooseRest: Choose the receipt line, a bill line, the bill unit and both quantities.
billMatching.matchButton: Match bill line to the receipt
billMatching.receiptNothingAccepted: {{number}} has nothing accepted yet — a receipt with nothing accepted cannot be matched
billMatching.currencyMismatchNote: This bill is in a different currency from the purchase order behind the receipt. The server refuses that match rather than inventing a rate.
billMatching.matchFooter: The match is recorded against the receipt line you choose. One bill line can be matched against several receipt lines (and the other way round) by submitting again with a different line — the server caps each match at what that line still has available, so nothing is over-allocated. Per-line matches are listed on the Receipts screen.
billMatching.noAcceptedLineDetail: Choose a receipt above to see its accepted lines.
billMatching.matchesLoadError: Recent matches could not be loaded.
billMatching.noMatchesTitle: No bill line has been matched yet

setup.registeredSitesDescription: A site fixes the branch, the inventory location and the project reference every document inherits.
setup.registeredConversionsDescription: Conversions are product-specific, explicit and evidenced, and always target the product base unit. No conversion is inferred or chained.
setup.noConversionsDetail: Without one, a purchase order can only use the product base unit.
setup.registerSiteDescription: The site maps a project reference to exactly one branch and one inventory location. Repeat registration of the same site code is idempotent.
setup.locationHint: The store that holds the material for this site.
setup.siteCodeHint: Short code used on every document for this site.
setup.projectRefHint: The reference material issues are booked against.
setup.siteRequiredReason: Branch, location, site code, site name and project reference are required.
setup.conversionDescription: One factor, one product, one direction — always into the product base unit. The server refuses chained or mismatched targets.
setup.factorHint: How many base units one “from” unit contains.
setup.evidenceHint: For example the supplier’s packaging specification.
setup.conversionRequiredReason: Product, both units, a positive factor and an evidence reference are required.
setup.policyNotice: Receipt posting policy {{state}}. GL posting remains structurally disabled.
setup.policyDescription: The only switch that lets a goods receipt or a material issue move stock. Approving it needs a written reason and evidence, and it never enables journal posting.
setup.enableFromBill: Enable movement posting from the matched bill line
setup.approvalEvidenceHint: For example the board minute or accounting policy reference.
setup.policyInfo: Enabling this policy allows accepted quantities to reach stock at the evidenced bill-line cost. It does not create journal entries and does not change any expense treatment.
setup.policyRequiredReason: A written reason and an evidence reference are required.
